invariantFindings: Review grants are scoped to exact request, event, message SHA-256 and review-key identities, a validated Target, bounded expiration, execution duration and message quota.
Unused-message transfer requires a prior revoked grant, unexpired predecessor, later target generation and different target digest.
Transferred identities must exactly match predecessor identities and have no prior reservations. Reserved, dispatched and unknown-outcome messages cannot transfer.
Global identity maps require every repeated request, event, message hash and review key to reference the same immediate predecessor. This prevents branching, identity substitution and quota reuse.
Transferred grant expiration and execution duration cannot exceed predecessor limits. Historical grant records remain unchanged.
New optional transfer metadata is omitted from serialization when absent, preserving legacy field representation. Compatibility with older strict readers after transfer remains intentionally limited.
Grant creation validates the complete resulting ledger before persistence. Invalid transfers fail without saving the proposed grant.
The reviewed tests cover successful restart transfer, changed payloads, target identity, expiration, quota, reserved or dispatched messages, unknown outcomes and chained transfers.
A review grant authorizes bounded dispatch only. It does not establish source review success, native execution permission, build qualification or release authority.
The inspected code supports fail-closed transfer identity and replay fencing, but full route, owner and browser transaction enforcement requires additional dependency inspection.

invariantFindings: Review reconciliation is explicitly non-submitting. Diagnosis of SENT delivery uses the existing snapshot reader and does not authorize a replacement send.
The SENT diagnosis path obtains a project Web-work lease, resolves the paired conversation target, and checks target ownership before and after snapshot inspection.
The inspected diagnosis returns verification status, bounded diagnostic information and target digest rather than private response text, drafts or full conversation URLs.
Missing assistant responses, duplicate USER messages, timeouts and response-load errors remain UNVERIFIED. Diagnostic observation does not resolve project work or authorize retries.
Tests assert that foreign-project requests and corrupted receipts fail before invoking the browser snapshot reader.
SUBMITTING deliveries remain on the existing reconciliation path. A missing historical dispatch authorization cannot be converted into a successful receipt.
The reviewed transfer tests confirm that a failed authorization transfer for alpha does not prevent independent beta authorization and reservation.
The diagnosed-read concurrency regression asserts that a sibling target read completes while another project's preparation is deliberately delayed. Both threads are released and joined.
Handoff Git state distinguishes UNKNOWN from SOURCE_REPORTED. Source evidence is not treated as independent native Git attestation.
The inspected routes support project isolation and no-resend intent, but complete enforcement depends on additional reader, lease and ledger implementations.
